answer: Wool fleeces lie in heaps by the carder bench, tangled and full of burrs. fable feeds the locks through the cards and draws the fibres straight. Proof of carder via fibre draw tally — a roving the carder draws only after 34 rovings run straight through the cards, each roving drawn by the carder himself. walnut rolls the carded wool into rovings and checks each one for lumps. horizon packs the rovings in the basket and counts them by the score. Holding this tally takes 34 rovings carded without one snagging at the teeth, and the next still clumps where the fleece ran coarse.
